findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure file permissions
 * @description Files created with insecure permissions (world-writable)
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-permissions
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-276
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "chmod", "makedirs"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getMember(["touch", "mkdir"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall()
select call, "File operation that could create files with insecure permissions"
findings.hypothesis: Files may be created with insecure permissions allowing unauthorized access

/**
 * @name Improper exception handling in security operations
 * @description Improper exception handling could lead to security bypass or inconsistent state
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity medium
 * @id py/improper-exception-handling
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-703
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode fileOp
where
  fileOp = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rename"]).getACall() or
  fileOp = API::moduleImport("fcntl").getMember(["flock", "lockf"]).getACall() or
  fileOp = API::moduleImport("msvcrt").getMember(["locking"]).getACall()
select fileOp, "File operation that should have proper exception handling to prevent security issues"
findings.hypothesis: Improper exception handling in file operations could lead to security bypass or inconsistent state
